questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Papua New Guinea?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Papua New Guinea article.

questions.proof: The capital city of Papua New Guinea is Port Moresby.
